question: What is the worst-case time complexity of QuickSort when a naive deterministic pivot is chosen on an already sorted array?

question: Which sorting algorithm guarantees O(n log n) worst-case time complexity while performing stable sorting?

option_b: Heap Sort
option_c: Selection Sort
option_d: Quick Sort
explanation: Merge Sort divides the array into halves recursively and merges them in linear time, guaranteeing O(n log n) worst-case time complexity while maintaining relative order of equal elements (stable).

question: What is the worst-case time complexity of lookup, insertion, and deletion in a balanced Red-Black Tree with n nodes?

question: Which data structure is primarily utilized to implement Breadth-First Search (BFS) on a graph?

option_d: Stack

option_d: O(V + E)
explanation: The Floyd-Warshall algorithm computes all-pairs shortest paths using three nested loops iterating over vertices, resulting in O(V³) time complexity.

option_d: n log n

question: In an AVL tree, what is the valid range of the balance factor (height of left subtree minus height of right subtree) for any node?
